app.name: Nova Prism
app.long_description:
Blast through the Crystal Caverns with four weapons, turn on a dime to fight in both directions, and take down the Hexacore.
Controls (Classic Controller): Left stick / D-Pad: fly A: Pulse Blaster (hold; watch the heat) B: Nova Blade (hold; spinning sabres, cut bullets) X: Swarm Missiles (8 homing missiles) Y: Prism Lance (screen-wide beam) L / R: turn around +: pause -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
